# Borda's AI-Rig

> Independently installable Claude Code and Codex plugins for evidence-first Python, ML, and open-source maintenance. The suite exposes 39 Claude skills across five plugins, 20 Codex skills across two plugins, 16 Claude agents, and 15 Codex Rig role cards. Codemap-py's six skills are available in both host totals.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/): Product selection, complete skill inventory, installation, first workflows, boundaries, update, and removal
- [Foundry](https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/cc_foundry/): 11 skills, 10 specialist agents, 13 rules, 15 hook modules, setup, audit, calibration, session state, and current limits
- [OSS](https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/cc_oss/): 5 maintainer skills, 4 agents, GitHub evidence collection, PR review, feedback resolution, release-readiness assessment, and human-owned public actions
- [Develop](https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/cc_develop/): 7 validate-first Python skills for planning, features, fixes, refactors, debugging, review, and setup
- [Research](https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/cc_research/): 10 ML research skills, 2 agents, literature grounding, experiment planning and review, bounded runs, verification, ablation, retrospectives, and Kaggle notebooks
- [Codemap-py](https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/codemap-py/): 6 dual-runtime skills for static Python indexing, queries, test impact, renames, integration, and telemetry debriefs
- [Codex Rig](https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/codex-rig/): 13 evidence-first workflows, 1 lifecycle manager, 15 role cards, shared gates, artifacts, confidence contracts, and runtime fallbacks

## Runtime guides

- [Claude Code guide](https://github.com/Borda/AI-Rig/blob/main/.claude/README.md): Complete Claude skill, agent, rule, and hook inventory with setup and cleanup behavior
- [Codex guide](https://github.com/Borda/AI-Rig/blob/main/.codex/README.md): Codex product selection, installation, first workflows, artifacts, and runtime boundaries
- [Codex Rig role cards](https://github.com/Borda/AI-Rig/blob/main/plugins/codex-rig/roles/README.md): Complete Codex specialist-role inventory, ownership boundaries, and packaged role-card contract

## Articles

- [Executed, Not Retyped: What 27 Runs Taught Me About Bash Inside Agent Skills](https://levelup.gitconnected.com/executed-not-retyped-what-27-runs-taught-me-about-bash-inside-agent-skills-72f273fdb341): Level Up Coding, Sep 2026; why a model's retyped bash block can differ from the skill's original, measured on AI-Rig's Claude Code skills
- [From Two Days of EDA to "Solve This Competition": A Kaggle Workflow, Compressed](https://pub.towardsai.net/from-two-days-of-eda-to-solve-this-competition-a-kaggle-workflow-compressed-aa5cea49c416): Towards AI, Sep 2026; agent-assisted Kaggle workflow behind the Research plugin's competition skill
- [One Tool, Two Agents: What It Actually Costs to Support Both](https://medium.com/codex/one-tool-two-agents-what-it-actually-costs-to-support-both-91b5d9be8130): CodeX, Sep 2026; Codemap-py structural engine ported to a second agent platform, and where assumptions broke
- [Reviewed Plugin Code Shouldn't Ask Permission](https://levelup.gitconnected.com/reviewed-plugin-code-shouldnt-ask-permission-aad049906e14): Level Up Coding, Sep 2026; blueprint-manifest auto-allow and the provenance fix for reviewed plugin code
- [Peers, Not Rivals: A Two-Way Street Between Claude Code and Codex](https://levelup.gitconnected.com/peers-not-rivals-a-two-way-street-between-claude-code-and-codex-9efcd04e13e4): Level Up Coding, Sep 2026; bridge between Claude Code and Codex (transport, authentication, bidirectional workflows), see https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/bridge_cc-codex/
- [A Structural Index Pays Off Most Where the Model Is Weakest](https://medium.com/codex/a-structural-index-pays-off-most-where-the-model-is-weakest-4b4bb3349921): CodeX, Aug 2026; controlled refactoring-benchmark results on token savings and quality, see https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/codemap-py/
- [Your Coding Agent Is Flying Blind — And IDEs Fixed This Twenty Years Ago](https://medium.com/codex/your-coding-agent-is-flying-blind-and-ides-fixed-this-twenty-years-ago-4cf3bfaf1999): CodeX, Aug 2026; terminal agents regressed to grep and a stdlib-only plugin that restores structural lookup, see https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/codemap-py/
- [My Benchmark Lied to Me Twelve Times Before It Told the Truth](https://medium.com/codex/my-benchmark-lied-to-me-twelve-times-before-it-told-the-truth-12a59948b7ef): CodeX, Aug 2026; how an evaluation harness deceives its builder when comparing two coding agents
- [Role Cards, Not Agents: A Three-Tier Fallback for Native Codex Plugins](https://medium.com/codex/role-cards-not-agents-a-three-tier-fallback-for-native-codex-plugins-8f647344cefc): CodeX, Jul 2026; lessons from building Codex Rig, see https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/codex-rig/
- [How I Streamlined OSS Maintenance With AI — Guardrails, Speed, and a Shepherd's Touch](https://medium.com/codex/how-i-streamlined-oss-maintenance-with-ai-guardrails-speed-and-a-shepherds-touch-55a955160abc): CodeX, Jun 2026; specialist agents for triage, review, and release with human-gated output, see https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/cc_oss/
- [The Open-Source Shepherd: Why Your Best Work Is Building a Project That Doesn't Need You](https://medium.com/codex/the-open-source-shepherd-why-your-best-work-is-building-a-project-that-doesnt-need-you-bfd0641f5aca): CodeX, Jun 2026; growing contributors and shared ownership in open-source projects, see https://borda.github.io/AI-Rig/cc_oss/
- [Author on Medium](https://medium.com/@jborovec): All posts by the AI-Rig author
